title: REQ · Pill and icon controls cover loading, error with retry, empty and sound and settings states
summary: Status pill shows each state on the kit and icon buttons stay wired to uiStore.
description: Context: error, loading and empty states render as bare spans, and icon buttons are plain frame buttons. Desired behavior: the state messages appear inside the same pill (test id round-pill with data-state loading, error or empty), Retry stays a frame button, and sound and settings icons sit in a labelled control group. Expected result: every status is covered and wired to real props and uiStore. Why: the Done-when requires tests for loading, error and retry.
acceptance_criteria: Given loading, when rendered, then the pill has data-state loading with text Loading round… and no timer.
Given error, when rendered, then the pill has data-state error with role alert text Round unavailable: <error> and Retry calls onRetry once.
Given no round, when rendered, then the pill has data-state empty with No active round.
Given the icon group, when sound or settings is clicked, then uiStore changes.
technical_constraints: No mock data in place of API; Zustand store stays.
